rule: the first line starts at 1.5 s. Narrator lines are 0.6 s apart; inside a conversation lines follow each other 0.25 s apart, like a real chat or call; 0.6 s between the narrator and a conversation, and 0.9 s between two different conversations. +1.2 s before 04_meet, t1_record (Under the hood) and 15_proof; +0.8 s before 08_aladdin (the channel locks in); +0.6 s before vc_a1 (the phone rings) and 14_operator (out of Under the hood). The end card holds 3 s after the last line. Narrator = Neha (audio/vo_neha), agent = Ritu and borrower = Pooja (audio/dialogue).

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every month, millions of people in India repay a loan. For a phone, a bike, a small shop.
lines.en: Every month, millions of people in India repay a loan. For a phone, a bike, a small shop.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: And every month, lenders remind them the same way. Same message. Same time. To everyone.
lines.en: And every month, lenders remind them the same way. Same message. Same time. To everyone.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Most of those messages are ignored. Some annoy people. And every single one costs money.
lines.en: Most of those messages are ignored. Some annoy people. And every single one costs money.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Meet Kairos. An AI that runs loan collections, one person at a time.
lines.en: Meet Kairos. An AI that runs loan collections, one person at a time.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every morning, Kairos looks at each borrower. How late they are, how they replied before, and when they usually read their messages.
lines.en: Every morning, Kairos looks at each borrower. How late they are, how they replied before, and when they usually read their messages.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Then it decides. Contact them today, or wait.
lines.en: Then it decides. Contact them today, or wait.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: It picks the channel. SMS, WhatsApp, a voice call in their language, or a human. And the best time of day.
lines.en: It picks the channel. SMS, WhatsApp, a voice call in their language, or a human. And the best time of day.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Before anything is sent, Aladdin, our safety supervisor, checks it against the lender's rules. Twice.
lines.en: Before anything is sent, Aladdin, our safety supervisor, checks it against the lender's rules. Twice.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: No messages at night. Never more than allowed. And if someone says stop, everything stops. On every channel.
lines.en: No messages at night. Never more than allowed. And if someone says stop, everything stops. On every channel.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: Please stop messaging me.
lines.en: Please stop messaging me.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: Understood. You won't get any more messages from us.
lines.en: Understood. You won't get any more messages from us.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: When a borrower writes back on WhatsApp, Kairos answers in seconds, in Hindi or in English.
lines.en: When a borrower writes back on WhatsApp, Kairos answers in seconds, in Hindi or in English.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: नमस्ते, मेरी EMI कब ड्यू है?
lines.en: Hi, when is my EMI due?

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: नमस्ते सुनीता जी! पहले आपकी पहचान कन्फर्म कर लूँ। आपके रजिस्टर्ड नंबर पर एक OTP भेजा है।
lines.en: Hello Sunita ji! First let me confirm it's you. I've sent an OTP to your registered number.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: OTP है चार आठ दो नौ।
lines.en: The OTP is 4829.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: धन्यवाद! आपकी EMI, चार हज़ार दो सौ पचास रुपये, कल ड्यू है। क्या मैं पेमेंट लिंक भेज दूँ?
lines.en: Thank you! Your EMI of ₹4,250 is due tomorrow. Shall I send a payment link?

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: हाँ, भेज दीजिए।
lines.en: Yes, please send it.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: लिंक भेज दिया है। पेमेंट होते ही मैं कन्फर्म कर दूँगी।
lines.en: Link sent. I'll confirm as soon as the payment lands.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: नमस्ते, मैं डेमो फाइनेंस की तरफ़ से बोल रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात सुनीता जी से हो रही है?
lines.en: Hello, I'm calling from Demo Finance. Am I speaking with Sunita ji?

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: हाँ, बोलिए।
lines.en: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: आपकी EMI पिछले हफ़्ते ड्यू थी। क्या आप शुक्रवार तक पेमेंट कर पाएँगी?
lines.en: Your EMI was due last week. Could you pay by Friday?

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: हाँ, शुक्रवार को कर दूँगी।
lines.en: Yes, I'll pay on Friday.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: बहुत अच्छा। मैंने शुक्रवार का वादा नोट कर लिया है, और आपको एक रिमाइंडर भेज दूँगी।
lines.en: Great. I've noted your promise for Friday, and I'll send you a reminder.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: It confirms who they are before sharing any loan details. And if someone sends a fake payment screenshot, it checks with the bank, and catches it.
lines.en: It confirms who they are before sharing any loan details. And if someone sends a fake payment screenshot, it checks with the bank, and catches it.

lines.speaker: pooja
lines.text: मैंने पेमेंट कर दिया है, ये रहा स्क्रीनशॉट।
lines.en: I've paid, here's the screenshot.

lines.speaker: ritu
lines.text: शुक्रिया! बैंक में अभी ये पेमेंट नहीं दिख रहा। मैंने इसे वेरिफिकेशन के लिए टीम को भेज दिया है।
lines.en: Thanks! The bank doesn't show this payment yet. I've sent it to the team to verify.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every reply, and every payment, teaches Kairos something new. So it gets better, every single day.
lines.en: Every reply, and every payment, teaches Kairos something new. So it gets better, every single day.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Under the hood, every borrower lives in one record. Loans, payments, replies, consent.
lines.en: Under the hood, every borrower lives in one record. Loans, payments, replies, consent.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: A learning model scores every channel and every hour for them, using what worked for similar borrowers in their region, and for them personally.
lines.en: A learning model scores every channel and every hour for them, using what worked for similar borrowers in their region, and for them personally.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Before a message is queued, Aladdin reserves the budget and the contact limit. At the moment of sending, it checks the rules again.
lines.en: Before a message is queued, Aladdin reserves the budget and the contact limit. At the moment of sending, it checks the rules again.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Messages go out through each channel's API. Delivery, read and reply receipts come back as webhooks. Duplicates are ignored.
lines.en: Messages go out through each channel's API. Delivery, read and reply receipts come back as webhooks. Duplicates are ignored.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Replies are understood by rules first, then a small model, then Sarvam's decision model. If it's still unsure, a human decides.
lines.en: Replies are understood by rules first, then a small model, then Sarvam's decision model. If it's still unsure, a human decides.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Every outcome is written back, and the model updates. Same data in, same decision out. Every step, on the record.
lines.en: Every outcome is written back, and the model updates. Same data in, same decision out. Every step, on the record.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: And the collections team? They watch the money come in, and approve the few decisions that need a human.
lines.en: And the collections team? They watch the money come in, and approve the few decisions that need a human.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: In our tests, Kairos recovered about twice as much money for every rupee spent, compared to a fixed schedule.
lines.en: In our tests, Kairos recovered about twice as much money for every rupee spent, compared to a fixed schedule.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: With zero rule breaches. And every safety test passed.
lines.en: With zero rule breaches. And every safety test passed.

lines.speaker: neha
lines.text: Kairos. The right message, at the right time. Or none at all.
lines.en: Kairos. The right message, at the right time. Or none at all.
